positive.why: варианты меню через = ANY вместо OR
positive.sql: SELECT (SELECT name FROM person WHERE person.id = person_order.person_id) AS name FROM person_order WHERE menu_id = ANY (ARRAY[13, 14, 18]) AND order_date = '2022-01-07';

negative.sql: SELECT (SELECT name FROM person WHERE person.id = person_order.person_id) AS name FROM person_order WHERE menu_id IN (13, 14, 18) AND order_date = '2022-01-07';
SELECT person.name AS name FROM person_order JOIN person ON person.id = person_order.person_id WHERE (menu_id = 13 OR menu_id = 14 OR menu_id = 18) AND order_date = '2022-01-07';

negative.why: OR без скобок: условие даты относится только к последнему меню
